autonomous_boundary.current_rule: At target i between flips, I_i=level_multiplier*nominal_mean_i*(1+0.2*sign_i), held constant over that interval
autonomous_boundary.flip_rule: Initial sign at t=0; first flip at wait_us. At every scheduled flip toggle sign, draw next strictly positive wait and add it to prior flip time. Process exact integer-microsecond flips in ascending (time_us, source_id) order.
autonomous_boundary.rng_algorithm: Python random.Random MT19937, runtime version pinned in checkpoint identity
autonomous_boundary.source: Same explicit inverse-CDF/MT19937 convention as the project's historical DN boundary, with new independent Candidate 1 streams
autonomous_boundary.wait_us: max(1, round(-100000*log1p(-u))) where u is the next stream random() and round is Python ties-to-even
autonomous_boundary.waiting_distribution: independent inverse-CDF exponential intervals with continuous mean 100000 microseconds

chemical_current.arrival_rule: At exact arrival microsecond add the weight captured at presynaptic spike emission to the target's chemical-current state. Do not change voltage instantaneously.
chemical_current.between_events: S(t+dt)=S(t)*exp(-dt/5000); integrate LIF voltage with the exact exponential-current kernel specified in the report, including during refractory reset clamp
chemical_current.model: signed voltage-equivalent impulse into a decaying current state
chemical_current.same_time_order: Sort arrivals by (due_us, post_source_id, pre_source_id, source_row, insertion_sequence); apply after boundary flips and before integration beyond this time
chemical_current.source: Existing project LIF reference uses an exponential current state; 5 ms is an explicit engineering choice for this candidate, not measured MaleCNS kinetics

event_ties.interior_events: Split neural integration at every chemical arrival, graded APL arrival, boundary flip, delayed sensory or PAM current change, and threshold tick. Apply all state discontinuities before integrating the next positive interval.
event_ties.interval_rule: For every event time t, first integrate the open interval from the previous event to t using the state effective in that interval. Then apply same-time discontinuities in priority order. A discontinuity at t changes state for the next positive interval and cannot retroactively change voltage at t.
same_instant_priority: current visible observation and sensory schedule
boundary flips in source ID order
PAM current request/pulse transitions and delayed sensory-current changes
chemical and KC-to-APL arrivals in canonical order
integrate through interval ending at threshold tick
local gamma4 update from pre-batch traces
fixed DNp42 readout and key transition
game judgement, first-action assignment and feedback request
ledger flush and committed checkpoint cut

full_runner_interface.checkpoint: Follow MVP-C1-checkpoint-v1; save exact boundary RNG/next flips, APL state/arrivals, chemical current and captured-weight arrivals plus all A2.1 owners at the committed cut. Validate all before mutation.

future_event_owners.gamma4_weight_update: PAM current and gamma4 local rule
future_event_owners.pam_pulse_start_end: PAM current and gamma4 local rule

full_runner_interface.identity: Resolved B2.1 config SHA, B2 base SHA, B2.1 addendum SHA, B2 runtime mask SHA, B1 anatomy SHA, normalized source hashes and code/backend identity
full_runner_interface.modulatory_class: All measured PAM08 outputs retained as anatomical/modulatory records; actual PAM08 spikes alone drive the local gamma4 trace
owners: PAM current and gamma4 local rule
full_runner_interface.roster: 718 pinned B1 source IDs: 717 explicit spiking states plus graded APL 10977
full_runner_interface.source_graph: All induced source pairs retained in immutable anatomy ledger; only declared active classes reach the electrical scheduler. UNKNOWN_QUARANTINED_NO_CURRENT pairs are audited and receive no numerical current.

checkpoint: queued KC-to-APL arrival records with origin, source row and insertion sequence
graded_apl.input_rule: Every measured KC-to-APL pair schedules a graded input at KC spike time plus 2000 us, with amount equal to pair contact count divided by all selected-KC-to-APL contacts. At arrival time decay L to that time, sum all same-time increments in canonical source-row order, then clamp L to [0,1].
graded_apl.integration_rule: Between events L(t+dt)=L(t)*exp(-dt/20000). Integrate its continuous output with the exact exponential-current LIF kernel, including the tau_apl=tau_membrane limit. Graded output begins only after a due KC-to-APL arrival, affects the following interval, and creates no APL spike or chemical arrival.
graded_apl.model: one nonspiking global graded state L in [0,1]
graded_apl.output_rule: For each measured APL-to-target pair in the selected roster, use inhibitory voltage-equivalent current -0.2*L. The per-target APL effect-class denominator equals that pair's own contact count; no unmeasured APL target is added.
graded_apl.same_time_rule: Boundary flips, then chemical and KC-to-APL arrivals, then integration beyond that time; arrivals change L but do not jump target voltage at the same instant. At a threshold tick, finish integration, emit one simultaneous spike batch and schedule later arrivals.
graded_apl.source: Graded APL role is literature-constrained; one global state, gain, normalization and exact 20-ms decay are engineering assumptions

B2_1_dynamics_addendum.provenance: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; selected before an MVP-C1 neural or task run, not fit to task performance
B2_1_dynamics_addendum.stop: Design and static validation only; no full neural runner, A2.2/A2.3 full replay, B3 intervention, training or parameter tuning

apl.input: sum of measured KC-to-APL arrivals normalized by all active KC-to-APL contacts; add to decayed state and clip to [0,1]
apl.output: state times inhibitory contact-share magnitude to measured APL targets only
apl.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; no ordinary APL spike conversion

boundary.meaning: artificial autonomous proxy for omitted inputs to MBON05, MBON20 and DNp42
boundary.state: independent stationary ±1 stream per target, continuous across notes and feedback

effective_weight_policy.definition: For each target and named effect class, absolute pair strength equals class_gain times source contact count divided by all active source contacts of that class entering the target; sign is separate
effective_weight_policy.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; contact count used only as a declared model transform

event_order: background flips and artificial PAM requests
neural integration and simultaneous spike batch
local trace and weight updates from pre-event traces
fixed motor decision and key action
game judgement and new feedback request

first_action.denominator: every eligible note, including no DOWN
first_action.first_down_scope: first emitted lane-one DOWN assigned by A3 causal note-identity contract; later presses never rescue
first_action.ruleset: OD8 stable native generated lane-one tap notes

generic_neuron_assumptions.source: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION; not measured MaleCNS physiology

model_units.weight: nonnegative excitatory or inhibitory magnitude, effect sign stored separately

motor.mapping: fixed positive DNp42 spike-count threshold; no trainable decoder

plastic_contact_mask.aggregation: Runtime pair conductance is split into fixed and plastic contact contributions; only the plastic contribution changes
plastic_contact_mask.rule: Both KC-to-MBON05 contact endpoints in g4(L), and same KC has at least one PAM08-to-KC contact with both endpoints in g4(L)

plasticity.source: Temporal polarity literature-constrained; equations, constants and bounds ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
plasticity.trace_update: Before each tick decay x_i and d; after weight update add 1 to x_i for each KC spike and fraction of all 25 PAM08 cells spiking to d, each capped at 1
plasticity.weight_update: If both KC and PAM spike in the same tick, apply depression -eta*w0*max(x_pre,1)*P and no potentiation. Otherwise KC spike applies +eta*w0*d_pre and PAM event applies -eta*w0*x_pre*P. P is actual PAM08 spike fraction. Apply only to selected contact contribution and clip after summing events.

renderer.position_between: linear interpolation in renderer from the current scene clock; encoder receives only current rendered position

sensory.geometry: 16 equally spaced Gaussian receptive-field centers over visible position; KC source IDs sorted, rank mod 16 selects center

B2_base_design.source: MaleCNS v1.0 traced-only; existing connectome_source.json and B1 hashes

teaching.early_judged_press: After note consumption and one fixed sensory-latency interval, deliver nonnegative PAM08 pulse; preceding KC trace supports depression
teaching.end_of_sequence_pending_late: Discard and log pending prime; no unseen next cue
teaching.late_press_or_no_down: Store only the prior outcome category/amplitude; at the next actual visible note onset deliver PAM08 pulse while the new cue's KC drive waits for its fixed sensory latency, so subsequent KC activity can support potentiation
teaching.pam_drive: 20 ms artificial current pulse at 2 normalized threshold units times requested amplitude to all 25 PAM08 cells
teaching.spontaneous_pam_activity: Included in local dopamine state and logged
teaching.too_early_null_press: Record early failure but no teaching pulse because the cue may remain visible and temporal polarity is ambiguous

training_policy.allowed_changes_after_b3_failure: none within MVP-C1 without an explicit new version and candidate-budget decision
training_policy.frozen_evaluation: same encoder and motor; plasticity and exploration off; fresh notes

checkpoint_identity_mapping.resolved_config_sha256: hash of this resolved file; placed in run/checkpoint manifest, not embedded recursively
